sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: Nesocodon mauritianus is a small subshrub endemic to Mauritius. The plate shows thick leaves and hanging blue-green flowers; an exact size is not needed for identification.

sections.title: Flowers and pollination
sections.text: The flowers produce red nectar containing the pigment nesocodin. Day geckos of the genus Phelsuma are attracted to it and are considered probable pollinators; this is a well-supported hypothesis, not absolute certainty.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: No food use was documented in the sources consulted.
